name: Tasks
description: Per-session task list. Plan multi-step work, mark progress as you go, the user sees a live TODO. Single Task tool with action switch (add, add_many, replace_plan, update, status, start, done, remove, reorder, list, clear). Prefer add_many + tasks[]. Model and human boards use canonical ordinal ids. State lives at ~/.minimal-agent/sessions/<sid>.tasks.jsonl. Current task list is auto-injected every user turn as <ma::agent::tasks>.

tool.name: Task
tool.description: Manage a per-session task list. Plan additively with `add_many` + `tasks: [{title, children?}]` (aliases: `items`, flat `titles`). Use `replace_plan` only to explicitly replace the whole board. Mark progress with `start` / `done` using canonical ids such as `1` and `1a` from the board. Tool results begin with a plain `OK ...` acknowledgement; configured result verbosity and the next-turn `<ma::agent::tasks>` attachment use the same canonical ids with no separate position column. Last open child auto-promotes its parent - do not also `done` the parent.

id.description: Canonical task id from the current board or latest Task tool result, such as `1` or `1a`. Required for: update, status, start, done, remove.

title.description: Task title (single line). Required for: add. Optional for: update (at least one of title or status must be provided).

tasks.description: Preferred tree form for add_many or replace_plan, with optional depth-2 children. Each entry is `{title, children?}` where `children` is a string array of subtask titles. Mutually exclusive with `items` and `titles`. Cannot combine with `parent`.

children.description: Optional subtask titles under this parent (depth 2 only; strings, not nested objects).

titles.description: Flat list of task titles (alias). For add_many: send exactly one of `tasks` (preferred), `items` (same as tasks), or `titles`. Use `titles` only for a flat plan or a flat batch under `parent`.

items.description: Alias of `tasks`. Prefer `tasks`. Tree form: `{title, children?}[]`. Mutually exclusive with `tasks` and `titles`. Cannot combine with `parent`.

children.description: Optional subtask titles under this parent (depth 2 only; strings, not nested objects).

parent.description: Make this task a subtask of the given parent. Accepts the same shapes as `id`. Optional for: add, and for flat add_many with `titles`. Not allowed with tree `tasks`/`items`.

after.description: Insert the new task immediately after this task instead of at the end. Top-level only. Optional for: add.

status.description: New status. Required for: status. Optional for: update.

reason.description: Optional reason recorded when setting status to canceled.

order.description: Top-level task ids in the desired new order. Subtasks ride along with their parent. Required for: reorder.

filter.description: Filter for `list` (currently advisory, full set is always rendered).

format.description: Result content format. `text` returns a plain acknowledgement and, when applicable under the configured verbosity, a canonical-id task board. `json` returns the equivalent parseable shape. Human TUI display is always ANSI.

parallel.description: For `start`: accepted for compatibility. `start` always keeps other `doing` tasks as `doing` (no demotion).

force.description: For `clear`: override the refusal when any task is `doing`. Default false.
